title: School Shopping
content:
Sofia is at a store with her mother. She needs some school supplies.

— How many notebooks do you need? — her mother asks.

— I need three notebooks and one pen.

— How much is this pen?

— It is two dollars.

Sofia looks at the pencils.

— How many pencils are there in this pack?

— There are ten pencils — the shop assistant says.

— Great! How much is the pack?

— Five dollars.

Sofia puts it in her basket.

— We need some colored pencils too.

— How many do you need?

— Twelve, please.

Her mother looks at the basket.

— You have very good taste!

Sofia laughs.

— And I need very good school supplies!
